risk_summary: The disclosure is generally well quantified, but uses extensive standard forward-looking disclaimers and uncertainty language. Credit risk increased materially in 2020, reflected in the higher provision for credit losses, rising nonaccrual loans and non-performing assets, and exposure to COVID-19 and energy-price volatility. Liquidity and balance-sheet growth benefited from PPP and government stimulus, while low interest rates pressured margins.
